name: 3D Kenji Devcontainer
postCreateCommand: mkdir -p /tmp/3dkenji-build && (cd /workspace && tar --exclude='.git' -cf - .) | tar -xf - -C /tmp/3dkenji-build && cd /workspace && uv venv --python 3.11 && . .venv/bin/activate && uv pip sync /tmp/3dkenji-build/pyproject.toml && pip install --no-cache-dir /tmp/3dkenji-build
